segments.text: Well, here they come, Al Ahli.
Ivan Toney in your picture there.
Just behind him, Merih Demiral sporting a
pretty nice mustache there, bit of a new look for Demiral.
In the tunnels, it'll all be very friendly in the pre-match handshakes, but that's about where it ends.
Both these teams will be looking to send their own messages of intent tonight.
Al Ahli do come into this match as favorites. They are the only unbeaten side left in this tournament.
Nine wins and a draw from their 10 matches on their journey into this quarter-final.
Five wins from their first five league stage fixtures gave them a perfect start and a solid platform to build on.
